does: Reads an Agent Package and the spending limit its owner set, before the agent is installed. Hands back a statement of what the agent may reach and why, what it may spend, what it must never do, and what was accepted knowingly, or a refusal naming everything that stopped it.

offerings.name: Review this package
offerings.does: Reviews one Agent Package against its own declaration and its owner's spending limit, and answers with a statement or a refusal.

refusals:
Granting access, binding a credential, installing the agent, or changing the package. Any ask other than a review is declined.
Passing an access with no reason recorded against it.
Passing a package whose programs reach a system the declaration does not name. The refusal names that system.
Passing a package whose owner set no spending limit.
Repeating a credential value it found. The refusal names the file and the kind of credential, never the value.
escalates: Whether each recorded reason is good enough. The statement shows every reason, and a person decides.

records.name: the security statement or the refusal, as the reply to the request
